text:
alex: quick heads-up — during the staged ramp of release v3.5.1 i'm seeing a 5-10% spike in auth failures (502/503) on staging between 10:12–10:18. thinking we should unwind to v3.5.0 as a stopgap and iterate.
priya: ack. can we confirm it's a runtime change and not config? any obvious error traces?
sam: logs look like token fetch timeouts + upstream 503s right after model init. correlates with the new kv-cache tweak in this build.
alex: yep kv-cache flag is suspect. i don't want a full hotfix deploy right now — prefer unwind to stable and then a targeted patch.
maddie: fine by me. what's the rollback plan? auto vs manual?
ops_oncall: deploy-bot will auto-rollback if 5m p95 latency > 400ms AND error-rate > 3% for 2 consecutive checks — but that didn't trigger because checks were noisy. i'd suggest a manual unwind with a controlled traffic slice.
alex: agreed. manual unwind to v3.5.0, 25% traffic for 5m, monitor, then full cutover if stable.
priya: i'll update the release notes and changelog to mark the retreat and include root-cause placeholder. sam can you draft the customer-facing blurb? we should avoid technical detail.
sam: on it. draft: "We're reverting the most recent minor update due to higher-than-expected authentication errors in internal testing. We're reverting to the previous stable build while we investigate. No customer data impacted." — thoughts?
jordan: +1. add a link to the incident ticket: INC-4721 and a short ETA for next update (TBD).
alex: deploy command i'll run:
```
# manual unwind
./deploy rollback --service inference --to v3.5.0 --traffic-slice 25 --monitor 5m --note "safety-net unwind due to auth spikes"
```

deploy-bot: starting traffic shift: 0% -> 25% (step=manual)
ops_oncall: monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/svc-inference/latency?orgId=1
maddie: i'll watch errors and p95, pinging @priya when stable.
priya: i'll edit the changelog: add entry under 'Reverts' plus short line in release notes. drafting now.
sam: customer blurb posted to docs draft at https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v3.5.1 — please review.
alex: traffic slice at 25% now. initial metrics look good, error-rate down to baseline after cutover.
ops_oncall: confirming: p95 320ms, error-rate 0.9% over last 6m.
maddie: nice. can we accelerate to 100%? what pulse is everyone on?
priya: will wait 10m for confirmation, then proceed. updating release notes: "Reverted to v3.5.0 due to auth error spike; fix in progress." will add more detail post RCA.
sam: customer blurb updated and queued for send after final confirmation.
deploy-bot: traffic shift complete: 100% -> v3.5.0. job_id=jb_2026_3280012345 status=success
alex: unwind complete. good job team. next: RCA, disable kv-cache flag by default, add unit/regression test for token fetch edge.
jordan: logging RCA task: TASK-8912 assigned to sam+priya, ETA EOD tomorrow.
priya: noted. i'll follow up with legal/comms for any downstream notices if required.
maddie: leaving a short post-deploy note on the release thread and adding the changelog link.
alex: closing loop — thanks. i'll open a short postmortem doc and tag everyone. :thumbsup:
